svg.text: HIVENANCE — ALL AGENTS MAP (Governance + Risk Evidence + BUZZ)

xhtml:div.div: Arrows: Solid = live data/decision flow • Dashed = telemetry/feedback • Purple = Queen policy updates & governance telemetry
Routing rule: all arrows run only in gutters (no crossing through cards).

foreignObject.xhtml:div: Reads system telemetry (veto rate, drawdown, API health, BUZZ burn) and publishes ruleset_version, Hive State (GREEN/AMBER/RED), caps, quarantines, worker enable/disable, and emergency policy.
Streams ticks and builds candles; computes volume & spread. Facts only.
Balances, exposure, available funds, fee constraints. Feeds sizing checks.
Latency, websocket stability, API uptime. Produces reliability context.
Regime detection + hysteresis. Emits REGIME_UPDATE (name, confidence, since_ts).

xhtml:div.div: Each emits WORKER_SIGNAL (side, confidence, features, risk_tags).
Workers never execute trades and never bypass governance—they propose.

foreignObject.xhtml:div: Aggregates workers + regime alignment. Emits COUNCIL_DECISION (score, margin, recommendation) and may include risk.metrics (loss_streak, alpha_age).
Orchestrates timing (poll cadence), caches latest regime/signals, and routes decision objects to enforcement.
Merges risk evidence (defaults safe). Evaluates: VETO → SVS gates → regime gates → permit caps. If allowed: locks BUZZ stake (idempotent) and returns risk.triggered[] + evidence snapshot.
Captures veto causes (override, API meltdown, order hang), plus strategy health (loss streak, alpha age).
Calls /rules/enforce with request_id + runtime metrics: api_failures_60s, order_unconfirmed_ms, override_*. Places orders only within SwarmGuard permit.
Post-trade review + learning. Updates worker_loss_streak and alpha_age_minutes. Feeds Council/Performance.
Ledger (available/locked). Atomic + idempotent writes. Supports LOCK, RELEASE, SLASH. Receipts power UI + settlement.
“SwarmGuard Card” shows permit, BUZZ receipt, and risk.triggered with evidence snapshot. Includes manual stop.
Append-only events: signals, decisions, enforcement, orders, fills, risk triggers.
Persists candles/features, decisions/enforcements, orders/fills, worker stats, regimes.
Aggregates metrics (drawdown, expectancy, veto rate by rule, drift). Feeds Queen + Council tuning.
HMAC/JWT S2S auth · key vaulting · audit integrity.

g.text: Emergency stop: GLOBAL_DENY · freeze symbol · halt execution
